auditMethod: Offline independent re-evaluation of exported raw JSON/logs, pinned local core bytes, process identities, argument digests, official-parser outputs and frozen inspector/controller source. No cloud connection or repeated checkpoint/read was performed by the auditor.

budgetAfter.scope: Project three Pods only, launch-time/rate estimate, not reconciled bill

scope: All three cold JVMs report decoding/restoring the full service checkpoint. The separately compiled inspector reports full canonical core byte equality after restart; this audit validates its pinned implementation and exported proof chain, not a second network byte read. Outbox cursor/count/endpoint sequences are verified; all historical outbox payloads are not independently enumerated. No Pod restart, power-loss durability or backup restoration claim.
